question: Find the total surface area of a cuboid whose dimensions are 18 m, 6 m and 3 m.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cuboid = 2 × (lb + bh + hl)

Here, l = 18, b = 6, and h = 3.

TSA = 2 × (18 × 6 + 6 × 3 + 3 × 18)

TSA = 2 × (108 + 18 + 54) = 2 × 180 = 360 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 360 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (l) = 18 m

Breadth (b) = 6 m

Height (h) = 3 m

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid = 2 × (Length × Breadth + Breadth × Height + Height × Length)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5ff50ab3fc84ec35f2674b2382c8902caf38cf348ac197baadbb28f3dfee57e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (l × b + b × h + h × l)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (18 × 6 + 6 × 3 + 3 × 18)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (108 + 18 + 54)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 180

⇒ Total Surface Area = 360 m²

⇒ Therefore, **Option (4)** is the correct value.

**∴ The correct answer is 360 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four side walls is given by 2 × h × (l + b).

Volume of a Cuboid

The total space enclosed within the cuboid is V = l × b × h.

Length of Diagonal

The distance between the two farthest corners is √(l² + b² + h²).</p
